row.phrase: One row is one day in the station's earlier ledger: everything the monitoring stations recorded that day.

blocks.title: Control side: ground readings
blocks.blurb: Ground and weather readings watched from the control room.

blocks.title: Machine side: gas readings
blocks.blurb: Gas and heat readings watched from the machine side: the vents, the crater lake and the plant.

columns.name: date
columns.meaning: The day the readings were taken, written year-month-day. Each day appears once.

columns.name: record
columns.meaning: Which part of the record the day belongs to.

levels.training: the days used to build (train) the model
levels.held back: the days kept aside, never used to build the model, to test how well it predicts days it has not seen

columns.name: eruption_within_week
columns.meaning: Whether an eruption began that day or within the next six days.

levels.yes: an eruption began that day or within the next six days
levels.no: no eruption began in that time

columns.name: quake_count
columns.meaning: How many earthquakes the seismometers recorded that day.

columns.name: tremor_level
columns.meaning: How strong the volcano's continuous background shaking (tremor) was, on the observatory's tremor index.

columns.name: ground_swelling_cm
columns.meaning: How far the ground around the crater had swollen upward, measured by the GPS and tilt stations.

columns.name: wind_speed_km_per_h
columns.meaning: Wind speed at the monitoring stations.

columns.name: gas_ratio
columns.meaning: Carbon dioxide divided by sulfur dioxide in the gas coming out of the vents.

columns.name: sulfur_dioxide_tonnes_per_day
columns.meaning: How much sulfur dioxide the vents gave off that day.

columns.name: vent_temperature_c
columns.meaning: Temperature of the gas at the fumaroles (the steaming vents).

columns.name: lake_acidity_ph
columns.meaning: Acidity of the crater lake; lower pH means more acidic.

columns.name: resort_alarm
columns.meaning: The resort's warning-system flag: whether the resort's own alarm was sounding that day.
